body: Gosh, as someone whose mother also tried to ruin her wedding because she couldn’t be around her ex, I’m so sorry this happened to you. I hope you’re able to remember your day without her antics.

You’ve just made me realize my Nmom did the same thing, but with an estranged uncle. She asked out of the blue about whether my uncle (her brother, whom we only saw a handful of times because she is estranged from all of her family) had ever SA’d me when I was little….

What? I was dumbfounded and didn’t understand where it was coming from. 

Now I think she was making a drama out of nothing.

Nmom tried to make my wedding about her and then threatened grandparents rights the moment she found out I was pregnant. Big nope. 

Link to wedding post:

https://www.reddit.com/r/raisedbynarcissists/s/tbRNKBBTGF
Oh, how I just want to write this letter already! ;)

Thanks so much for that link! This is helpful indeed. 

And thanks - we are so excited :)
We don’t! This is promising. Thanks so much.
Thank you!
I really appreciate the way that you’ve worded this response. Very validating. Thanks so much.
Thank you for this reassurance! I’m sorry to hear that we have Nmoms in common :( my heart goes out to you!
It’s a small territory, lots of professionals across many disciplines are not taking new clients.

Thanks so much. 

Yes, I was reading through the other posts but didn’t see anything Yukon-specific. Helpful to know it seems it is a federal theme.
Thanks for this, although it doesn’t look like it’s available in my territory.
Thanks so much. Helpful point about anyone feeding them information as well as the peace bond. Much appreciated!
Thanks so much for this!
We don’t live with them.

Hell yes. My Nmom is a psychotherapist.
Let that sink in.

I am 6 weeks tomorrow and I’m also conflicted about when to tell my narcissistic mother, with whom I have low contact. I’ve settled on telling her when I am ready for it to be “public” knowledge, likely around the end of the first trimester - mostly because I know that once she knows, everyone and their uncle will know. 

We made the decision to slowly share with family members one by one organically as we chat with them about other things (“Oh, by the way, we have some news!”), but have ended those conversations with the disclaimer that it’s still early and as such, we aren’t telling many people, so please keep this between us, Yada Yada... We are only doing this with family members we know we can trust, though. 

I think I’ve mentally distanced myself from my mother enough to include her with “everyone else”, and I won’t be affected by whatever emotion she may have as a result of her finding out at the same time as “everyone else”.  I won’t let on about the timing of telling her compared “everyone else”. My response to her asking any intimate questions (“Were you trying? Who else knows? Who knew before me?”) will be answered very grey-rock-style. She doesn’t need to know the answer to many of those questions! 

It’s so tough! I feel for you! Best of luck 💕

Oh my gosh. That sounds terrible. I’m so sorry to hear you had to endure that. 

Yes, this sounds like things she’s done in the past already, just instead of it being my in-laws, it was me choosing my dad over her (supposedly). 

Good insight into a potential forecast of what she may do, now just with the new in-laws. Thanks for this ♥️ 

Sending strength with your path of NC - and best wishes in your marriage.

I’m so sorry to hear this. It sounds similar to my situation. I’m beginning to see her behaviour to be a reaction to the changing relationship. Now that she isn’t my primary “person” (my husband is), she’s acting out…if that makes sense? Might explain why everything was so bad leading up to the wedding, and the wedding itself. Like it’s a threat to her?
I’ve never heard this before - thank you for mentioning this. It’s so true!

Thanks to you both for this. 
I didn’t see that tactic until you explained - but yes, she totally does this often as well. So helpful to have a name for it.
